# Section 040: Pipelines

Makes the reader able to trace telemetry through the pipelines of an OpenTelemetry Collector and to predict what each component receives. It covers pipeline names and signal types, which components are shared and which are created for each pipeline, fan-out to several exporters, processor order, connectors between pipelines, and how the sending queue, retry and backpressure decide what a slow or failing exporter does to the sender and to the other exporters.

**Curriculum item covered:** Pipelines

---

## What You Will Master

- Read the `service.pipelines` section and tell which defined components start and which stay unused
- Name several pipelines of one signal type with the `type/name` form
- Explain which components exist once for each name and which exist once for each pipeline
- Predict what a shared receiver delivers to two pipelines when one of them changes the data
- Order processors so that removal runs before any copy of a value
- Explain why every exporter of a pipeline receives the same processed data
- Join two pipelines with the `forward` or `count` connector and read the start errors for one-sided connectors
- Describe the order of sending queue, retry and timeout inside an exporter
- Predict what the sender sees when a queue is enabled, disabled or full
- Read the `otelcol_exporter_*` metrics on port 8888 to see queue size, capacity and failures

## The Learning Path

### 1. Signal Paths, Shared Components And Fan-Out
*   **Module Reader:** **[Module 1: Signal Paths, Shared Components And Fan-Out](./module-01/course.md)**
*   **Hands-on Playground:** `sections/section-040/module-01/playground` — kind cluster in the `starfleet` namespace with a `gateway` Collector (otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib 0.162.0), a second Collector named `backend` as destination and a `shuttle` pod with curl. The `gateway` starts with one `traces` pipeline that exports to the `debug` exporter only.
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS075.git -c sections/section-040/module-01/playground
    ```

### 2. Connectors, Backpressure And Failure Behavior
*   **Module Reader:** **[Module 2: Connectors, Backpressure And Failure Behavior](./module-02/course.md)**
*   **Hands-on Playground:** `sections/section-040/module-02/playground` — the same kind cluster layout. The `gateway` starts with a `traces` pipeline that exports to `otlphttp/archive`, `otlphttp/backend` and `debug`. The Service `archive` does not exist, so the archive exporter fails on every attempt.
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS075.git -c sections/section-040/module-02/playground
    ```

### Section Capstone Challenge
*   **Comprehensive Challenge:** Pipelines Capstone — `sections/section-040/capstone/labs/lab-01`
    ```bash
    astrona run --git ssh://git@github.com/astrona-io/ATS075.git -c sections/section-040/capstone/labs/lab-01
    astrona submit -c .
    ```
*   **Hands-on Objective:** Repair a `gateway` that crash-loops at start because a connector has no exporter side. The reader then wires the unused `backend` exporter and the redaction processor, enables the archive queue and adds a logs pipeline. The grader posts telemetry with unique markers and reads the logs of the `backend` and the `gateway`.

All labs and playgrounds in this section are untested: they passed static checks only.
